notes: Found by tracing the original's ecx=&global calls through forwarders (a scratch scanner of this+off reads, which follows calls on this+k) and matching the offsets with layouts.json. Several 4-byte 'objects' are really the start of bigger objects whose fields got their own symbols: kSpeech_a5cf98 = Panels (0x134), b_a5d0d0 = SoundStream (0x24), kVideo_a5d2f0 = Video (0x30), b_a5d380 = CutScene (0x48), b_a5d408 = QuickBar (0x45f); the inner symbols carry part_of = owner and the type of that field. Text/Font labels are Font2d aliases. kModelRefs_a5d0f8: AnimBuf +0 must become a pointer (0x21b-byte ModelSlot records). Pointer arrays (b_a69a90, b_a69a94, b_a6a278, b_a673b8, b_a6785c, kPioinfo) change stride in x64. The 64-bit DXUtil timer values (b_a677e0..f8) are typed u32 x2 because the vocabulary has no 64-bit integer. Win32 structures in the image (OVERLAPPED, MCI_*_PARMS) are defined as classes because they hold pointer-sized fields. Counts: {'obj': 45, 'part_of': 48, 'scalar': 200, 'ptr': 51, 'bytes': 3}
